hooks.command: repo="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || repo="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"; [ -n "$repo" ] && dagayn status --repo "$repo" || echo 'Not a git repo, skipping'
repo="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || repo="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"; [ -n "$repo" ] && DAGAYN_HOOK_UPDATE=1 dagayn update --skip-flows --repo "$repo" || true
